title: Recursive context frontmatter, schema 1
description: Missing schema retains the fixed source's legacy schema-1 behavior. Runtime additionally checks path containment, exact placeholders, unique gate/layer IDs, reciprocal graph consistency and manifest facts. Unknown project metadata is extensible.

test_reachability.description: Root test reachability policy (v1). Proves declared file-level reachability from committed repository facts; does not prove runtime execution or individual test results (declaration-only evidence limits). Supported only in root context index or root tech-context.md.

command.description: Runtime additionally requires every token to encode as strict UTF-8; lone surrogate code points are rejected before discovery or gate execution. This is a semantic check beyond this structural schema.

reaches.description: Static discovery adapters declaring which candidate test files are reached by this test gate. Proves declared file-level reachability; declaration-only evidence limits apply.

test_reachability.description: Root test reachability declaration (v1). Requires version 1 and inventory defaults. Validates required gates against aggregate lanes, reasoned non_tests false positives, and reasoned deliberate exclusions.

version.description: Version integer (must be 1 for v1 contract).

inventory.description: Closed test candidate inventory. Defaults to default-v1 patterns with optional explicit include additions.

required_gates.description: Unique (layer, gate, aggregate_lane) mappings that bind declared test gates to canonical reusable quality workflow aggregate lanes. When omitted, defaults to an empty list (no required gate bindings are declared).

non_tests.description: Reasoned patterns for candidate matches that are false positives or tools rather than test files. When omitted, defaults to an empty list (no candidate matches classified as non-tests).

exclusions.description: Reasoned patterns for real test files deliberately excluded from PR CI verification. When omitted, defaults to an empty list (no test candidates deliberately excluded).

test_inventory.description: Closed test inventory configuration using default-v1 candidate patterns plus optional include globs.

defaults.description: Closed default candidate pattern family (default-v1). Cannot be replaced or weakened.

include.description: Optional nonstandard test globs added to the candidate inventory. When omitted, defaults to an empty list (relying solely on default-v1 patterns).

required_gate.description: Binding between a layer's test gate and a canonical reusable quality aggregate lane.

layer.description: Owning layer ID containing the test gate.

gate.description: Gate ID within the layer (must be kind: test and mode ci or both).

aggregate_lane.description: Canonical aggregate lane name in the reusable quality workflow.

reasoned_patterns.description: Array of pattern and reason records for candidate classification exceptions.

patterns.description: Nonempty list of git-relative glob patterns.

reason.description: Substantive reason for the exception classification.

reach_adapter.description: Static discovery adapter for test reachability. Supported adapters: swiftpm-v1 (SwiftPM test targets), xcodegen-v1 (XcodeGen test schemes), python-unittest-v1 (unittest discovery), pytest-v1 (pytest roots/files), node-test-v1 (node --test globs), vitest-v1 (Vitest include/exclude), ruby-v1 (Ruby test patterns), shell-v1 (shell test patterns), and declared-glob-v1 (manifest globs with source and reason). Opaque or dynamic runners fail closed without execution (declaration-only evidence limits).

package_path.description: Package root directory for swiftpm-v1. When omitted, derived from the literal gate command argument '--package-path <path>'; otherwise fails closed.

project.description: Path to XcodeGen project file (e.g. project.yml) for xcodegen-v1. When omitted, derived from literal gate command arguments; otherwise fails closed.

scheme.description: Xcode scheme name for xcodegen-v1 whose test action targets are reached. When omitted, derived from literal gate command argument '-scheme <name>'; otherwise fails closed.

start_directory.description: Discovery start directory for python-unittest-v1. When omitted, derived from literal gate command argument '-s <dir>' or '-s=<dir>'; otherwise fails closed.

pattern.description: Discovery filename pattern for python-unittest-v1 (e.g. 'test_*.py'). When omitted, derived from literal gate command argument '-p <pattern>' or '-p=<pattern>', or defaults to standard unittest 'test*.py'.

root.description: Root directory for pytest-v1 discovery. When omitted, derived from literal gate command arguments; otherwise fails closed.

python_files.description: List of filename patterns for pytest-v1 test discovery. When omitted, derived from literal pytest configuration or defaults to standard pytest patterns ('test_*.py' and '*_test.py').

patterns.description: List of literal test file glob patterns for node-test-v1, ruby-v1, shell-v1, or declared-glob-v1. For node-test-v1, when omitted, derived from literal gate command arguments or documented node --test default naming; for ruby-v1 and shell-v1, when omitted, derived from literal gate command arguments, otherwise fails closed; for declared-glob-v1, patterns is required.

include.description: List of literal inclusion globs for vitest-v1. When omitted, derived from literal Vitest configuration; otherwise fails closed.

exclude.description: List of literal exclusion globs for vitest-v1. When omitted, derived from admitted literal Vitest configuration; otherwise fails closed.

config.description: Path to configuration file for vitest-v1 (e.g. vitest.config.ts). When omitted, derived from literal gate command argument '--config <path>'; otherwise fails closed.

source.description: Path to the protected custom runner manifest containing literal test globs for declared-glob-v1. Required; cannot be omitted.

reason.description: Substantive reason explaining why custom runner globs are necessary for declared-glob-v1. Required; cannot be omitted.
